description: Canonical JSON normalization rules for record-level hashing (JSONL single-record scope).
input_scope: single JSON object record (JSONL one-line unit; no arrays; no multiple root objects)
notes: Input MUST satisfy I-JSON / JCS numeric constraints: no NaN/Infinity, no duplicate keys.
Unlike RFC 8785 JCS, canonicalizer_v1 requires NFC-normalized input strings.
rules: Input MUST be a valid JSON object at the root (no arrays).
Object keys MUST be sorted lexicographically (UTF-8, ascending).
Whitespace MUST be removed except inside string values.
Strings MUST be UTF-8 and NFC normalized.
String escaping MUST follow RFC 8259 standard escapes.
Numbers MUST follow ECMAScript JSON.stringify minimal form (equivalent to JCS).
No trailing newline is allowed in canonical output.

examples.notes: Examples show minimal ECMAScript JSON.stringify numeric form.
